page_review.notes:
Printed page 109 continues the 'List of LAIS and EB Courses Satisfying the H&SS Requirement' begun on printed page 108. Its left-column code/title/credit rows are a requirement eligibility list, not independent course entries or descriptions. The right column introduces Minor Programs and the Literature, Society, and the Environment Minor and ASI; its LAIS rows are explicitly required/elective choices within minor requirements. Printed page 110 continues those lists and minor-program material. No independent central-page course entry is visible.
Negative-page evidence: Previous page 108 explicitly heads the continuing left-column table 'List of LAIS and EB Courses Satisfying the H&SS Requirement'; central page 109 retains the same code/title/credit row styling through LIFL129. | Central page 109 right column is headed 'Minor Programs' and 'Literature, Society, and the Environment Minor and ASI'; the 'MINOR REQUIREMENTS' text introduces one required course and a three-course elective list. | Next page 110 continues the minor elective list and begins other minor-program descriptions, rather than a standalone course-description section.
